guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 以「可追溯時序、基準模型與不確定負載」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
guides.conceptEn: Follow traceable time series, baselines and uncertain demand through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
procedure: 在「功率與能量區別」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 100 kW，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「直接相加功率卻不乘時間會弄錯日能耗。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「時區與缺測」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.958333 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「補零會讓模型學到不存在的停機。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「季節性樸素基準」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 10 kW，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「沒有基準就宣稱AI較好缺乏比較依據。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「氣象與度時」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 6 K h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「使用預測時尚未知的實測未來天氣會造成資料洩漏。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「線性可解釋模型」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 90 kW，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把係數因果化可能忽略天氣和占用的相關性。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「時間外驗證」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.166667 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「隨機打散強季節資料可能高估未來預測能力。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「MAE與尖峰誤差」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 10 kW，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「平均誤差小仍可能在最重要尖峰嚴重低估。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「預測區間與涵蓋率」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.9 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「不斷加寬區間可提高涵蓋卻降低操作價值。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「概念漂移與重新校正」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 10 kW，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只用全歷史平均誤差可能稀釋近期漂移。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「預測轉為儲能調度」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 60 kWh，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把預測峰值直接當充放電命令會忽略儲能狀態。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
procedureEn: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for distinguish power and energy, first reproduce 100 kW, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Summing powers without time miscalculates daily energy." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for time zones and missing intervals, first reproduce 0.958333 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Zero-filling teaches a shutdown that never occurred." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for seasonal naive baseline, first reproduce 10 kW, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Claiming superior AI without a baseline lacks comparison." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for weather and degree-hours, first reproduce 6 K h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using unavailable future observed weather causes leakage." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for interpretable linear model, first reproduce 90 kW, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Interpreting coefficients causally can miss correlated inputs." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for out-of-time validation, first reproduce 0.166667 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Random shuffling of seasonal data can overstate future performance." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for mae and peak errors, first reproduce 10 kW, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Small average error can coexist with severe peak underprediction." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for prediction intervals and coverage, first reproduce 0.9 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Widening intervals raises coverage while reducing usefulness." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for concept drift and recalibration, first reproduce 10 kW, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "An all-history mean can dilute recent drift." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for translate forecasts into storage dispatch, first reproduce 60 kWh, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using forecast peaks directly as dispatch ignores storage state." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.
evidence: 把15分鐘資料聚合到小時並檢查能量守恆。
造一個缺測區間，標記而不把它當零負載。
比較昨日同時與上週同時兩個基準。
改變基準溫度，檢查不同季節殘差。
停用占用項並比較工作日與假日偏差。
用滾動起點依序預測下一週。
分別報尖峰時段和非尖峰時段MAE。
比較窄區間與寬區間的漏包情況。
模擬新增一台設備，檢查殘差是否持續偏正。
加入效率與容量限制，檢查是否仍可削峰。
evidenceEn: Aggregate15-minute data hourly and verify energy conservation.
Create a missing interval and flag it rather than treating it as zero.
Change base temperature and inspect seasonal residuals.
Remove occupancy and compare weekday/weekend bias.
Use rolling origins to predict each next week.
Report MAE separately for peak and off-peak periods.
Compare missed observations under narrow and wide intervals.
Simulate an added load and check sustained positive residuals.
Add efficiency and capacity limits and check feasibility.
pitfalls: 直接相加功率卻不乘時間會弄錯日能耗。
補零會讓模型學到不存在的停機。
沒有基準就宣稱AI較好缺乏比較依據。
使用預測時尚未知的實測未來天氣會造成資料洩漏。
把係數因果化可能忽略天氣和占用的相關性。
隨機打散強季節資料可能高估未來預測能力。
平均誤差小仍可能在最重要尖峰嚴重低估。
不斷加寬區間可提高涵蓋卻降低操作價值。
只用全歷史平均誤差可能稀釋近期漂移。
把預測峰值直接當充放電命令會忽略儲能狀態。
pitfallsEn: Summing powers without time miscalculates daily energy.
Zero-filling teaches a shutdown that never occurred.
Claiming superior AI without a baseline lacks comparison.
Using unavailable future observed weather causes leakage.
Interpreting coefficients causally can miss correlated inputs.
Random shuffling of seasonal data can overstate future performance.
Small average error can coexist with severe peak underprediction.
Widening intervals raises coverage while reducing usefulness.
An all-history mean can dilute recent drift.
Using forecast peaks directly as dispatch ignores storage state.

guides.scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

related.title: 首爾清溪川復育
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。
courses.summaryEn: The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
